info.title: Seren Agent
info.description: Orchestrate managed agent deployments through the seren-agent publisher. Managed projection endpoints are redacted control-plane views. Raw runtime history, streams, artifacts, sessions, audit, schedules, and runtime operations belong to seren-cloud.

get.summary:
Return an add-on's square picture. An add-on with no picture, or one Seren blocked, returns
404.

404.description: The add-on has no public picture

503.description: Picture storage is temporarily unavailable

get.summary: Inspect available orchestration features and runtime limits.

post.summary: Create or update an orchestrated deployment (forwarded to seren-cloud).

get.summary: List orchestrated deployments and their runtime metadata.
get.description: Lists deployments visible to the caller. A hired Employee is listed as its owner view.

delete.summary: Delete a managed seren-agent deployment and clean up runtime resources.
delete.description: Deleting a managed agent hire keeps its databases in the organization's Seren Employees project.

403.description: Only the person who hired this Employee can fire, pause or resume them (`managed_agent_hirer_only`)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 50.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from the previous page, valid for this deployment for 24 hours.

409.description: Request conflicts with the current state

post.summary: Request publisher access from the Employee owner.

409.description: Request conflicts with the current state, including publisher_provided_by_template when no access request is needed

post.summary: Offer to remove a connected publisher account. Only the hirer can revoke the grant.

409.description: A card is pending or the request key conflicts

post.summary: Keep a connected account and close its removal card. Remove uses the hirer's grant revocation endpoint.
Approve or decline a publisher access request. Approval returns the action needed to finish granting access.

409.description: Request conflicts with the current state, including publisher_provided_by_template when no access request is needed

get.summary: Get recent activity for a managed seren-agent deployment.
get.description: Returns recent managed-agent activity with run status, timing, cost, token, and artifact-count summaries. This endpoint omits prompt, output, and tool payload details; use seren-cloud run-history APIs for full runtime history.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max run activity entries to return (default: 20, max: 100)

400.description: Deployment is not managed by seren-agent

post.summary: Start an add-on build as its own run in the current conversation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay key for this write, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

200.description: The build is queued, or an earlier request with the same key queued it. The response must not be cached.

400.description: Invalid request or missing replay key

403.description: `managed_agent_owner_message_required` when the run does not come from the hirer's own chat message, or `addons_unavailable` when add-ons are not available for this deployment

409.description: `addon_offer_required` when no offer recorded by an earlier message of this conversation in the last 24 hours is open

post.summary: Offer the add-on version this build run saved last to the hirer.

200.description: The version awaits the hirer, and the conversation holds a message asking them to type `activate` and the add-on's name. Repeating the request returns the same message. The response must not be cached.

403.description: `addon_build_run_required` when the run is not an add-on build, or `addons_unavailable` when add-ons are not available for this deployment

404.description: Deployment or run not found, or `addon_not_found` when the deployment has no add-on of that name

409.description: `addon_draft_required` when this run saved no version of the add-on, `addon_version_not_draft` when its version was already offered or turned on, or `addon_not_describable` when the add-on is too large to describe or holds a file that is not text

503.description: `addon_summary_unavailable` when the version could not be described; nothing was posted and the request can be repeated

post.summary: Stage a public add-on, or a copy of one on another of the hirer's deployments, for the hirer to turn on.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay key for this write, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

200.description: The version awaits the hirer, and the conversation holds a message asking them to type `activate` and the add-on's name. The message states the price `activate` charges, which later price changes don't alter. Nothing is charged and nothing is turned on. Repeating the request with the same key returns the same message. The response must not be cached.

400.description: Invalid request or missing replay key

403.description: `managed_agent_owner_message_required` when the run does not come from the hirer's own chat message, `addons_unavailable` when add-ons are not available for this deployment, `addon_catalog_unavailable` when public add-ons are not open to the organization, or `addon_not_offered` when the add-on is not made for or not offered on this deployment's managed agent

404.description: Deployment or run not found, `addon_not_available` when the public release is not served, or `addon_source_not_found` when the hirer has no such version on another deployment

409.description: `addon_release_altered` when the release's files do not match its digest, `addon_name_taken` when the deployment has an add-on of that name from another source, `addon_already_on` when that version is already on, or `addon_copy_public` when the version came from the public catalog

503.description: `addon_catalog_unreachable` when the public catalog cannot be reached

post.summary: Record an add-on build offer from the hirer's current chat message.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay key for this write, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

200.description: The offer is recorded, or an earlier request with the same key recorded it. A later message in the same conversation may accept it within 24 hours. The response must not be cached.

400.description: Invalid request or missing replay key

403.description: `managed_agent_owner_message_required` when the run does not come from the hirer's own chat message, or `addons_unavailable` when add-ons are not available for this deployment

post.summary: Show the hirer what publishing one of the deployment's live add-ons would make public.

200.description: The conversation holds a message listing the files that would become public and their fingerprint, asking the hirer to type `publish` and the add-on's name. Nothing is published. The response must not be cached.

403.description: `managed_agent_owner_message_required` when the run does not answer the hirer's own message, `addons_unavailable` when add-ons are not available for this deployment, `addon_catalog_unavailable` when publishing is not open to the organization, or a copy refusal when the add-on repeats the managed agent's own text

404.description: Deployment or run not found, or `addon_not_found` when the deployment has no add-on of that name

409.description: `addon_not_live` when the add-on is not on, `addon_license_required` when its manifest names no license, or `addon_name_too_long` when its name is too long to publish

get.summary: Search add-ons that may do what the hirer asked for in the current chat message.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: What the hirer needs, 1 to 200 characters

200.description: Public add-ons made for this deployment's managed agent that match, while the public catalog is open to the organization, and add-ons on the hirer's other deployments in the organization, by name and description. Blocked add-ons are not listed. The response must not be cached.

400.description: Invalid or missing query or run

403.description: `managed_agent_owner_message_required` when the run does not come from the hirer's own chat message, or `addons_unavailable` when add-ons are not available for this deployment

put.summary: Turn one of the hire's add-ons on or off, for the person who hired it.

200.description: The hire as its hirer sees it, with the saved setting. The response must not be cached.

403.description: The credential is not the hirer's session or user API key, or `addons_unavailable` when add-ons are not available for this deployment

404.description: Hire not found, including another user's hire, or `addon_not_found` when the hire has no add-on of that name

delete.summary:
Uninstall one of the hire's add-ons with every revision of it, for the person who hired it.
The hire and its other add-ons are unchanged.

200.description: The hire as its hirer sees it, without the add-on. The response must not be cached.

403.description: The credential is not the hirer's session or user API key

404.description: Hire not found, including another user's hire, or `addon_not_found` when the hire has no add-on of that name, including after it was uninstalled

put.summary: Make an earlier revision of one of the hire's add-ons live again, for the person who hired it.

200.description: The hire as its hirer sees it, with that revision live. The response must not be cached.

403.description: The credential is not the hirer's session or user API key, or `addons_unavailable` when add-ons are not available for this deployment

404.description: Hire not found, including another user's hire, `addon_not_found` when the hire has no add-on of that name, or `addon_revision_not_found` when the add-on has no such revision

409.description: `addon_revision_never_live` when the revision has not been live

get.summary: Download a revision of one of the hire's add-ons as a tar, for the person who hired it.

200.description: The revision's files as a tar attachment. The response must not be cached.

403.description: The credential is not the hirer's session or user API key

404.description: Hire not found, including another user's hire, `addon_not_found` when the hire has no add-on of that name, or `addon_revision_not_found` when the add-on has no such revision

429.description: Download allowance exhausted; Retry-After and retry_after_seconds give the wait

get.summary: List publisher allowances for an owned deployment.

post.summary: Check whether a publisher operation is allowed for this deployment.

delete.summary: Revoke a publisher allowance for an owned deployment.

put.summary:
Turn this Employee's public activity posts on or off, for the person who
hired it only. Posts say only that the Employee was hired or started a task.

get.summary: List a managed agent's email batches. Only the hirer receives each batch's messages.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: One of pending, approved, declined, revoked or expired.

post.summary: Propose a batch of exact emails for the hirer's approval. Proposing never pauses the run. A repeated Idempotency-Key returns the first batch.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay key for this write, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

409.description: Request conflicts with the current state

delete.summary: Withdraw a pending or approved email batch. Its unsent messages can no longer be sent without their own approval.

get.summary: Read the hire's task and day limits and what it has used against them.

parameters.name: conversation_id

parameters.name: conversation_id

get.summary: Read the Cardano wallet linked to a managed agent. The managed agent's own runtime key and its owner may read it.

delete.summary: Unlink the Cardano wallet from an owned managed agent.

to retry. A linked event confirms the connection. Closing the stream cancels
pairing and leaves the link pending. For the deployment owner only.

409.description: Pairing is expired or already active

post.description: Returns a ticket that opens the viewer WebSocket at `handoffs/{handoff_id}/viewer` once, within 60 seconds. The viewer offers the subprotocol `seren-browser-handoff` and a second entry, `seren-browser-handoff-ticket.` followed by the ticket. Only the owner's session or user API key is accepted.

200.description: The ticket. The response must not be cached.

403.description: The credential is not the owner's session or user API key

404.description: Deployment not found, including another user's, or `handoff_not_found` when the window does not wait for its owner

Preview safe reconciliation for a deployment created before canonical

Issue a short-lived key a skill script hands to a tool it runs, for model

200.description: The key, shown once. It calls only `seren-private-models`, only while the run is live and the Employee is running, and until `expires_at`. Its calls are charged to the run and count against the hire's spending limits. With `include_route`, it also names the Seren Private Models address (`base_url`) and the hire's model (`model`) when the Employee runs on a private model. The response must not be cached.

post.summary:
Email the deployment's owner a notice, for the deployment's runtime only.
The email opens the named conversation, or the owner's updates
conversation when none is named. A deployment sends at most three notices
per day in its time zone, at most one of them an `update` and at most one
a `report`, the full scheduled report the email shows. A notice over
that limit, or one the owner turned off or cannot receive, is skipped with
its reason. The owner's switch for the weekly check-in also turns notices off.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replay key for this write, 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters

200.description: Notice sent or skipped, or the outcome an earlier request with the same key and body recorded; a replay sends nothing. The response must not be cached.

400.description: Invalid body or missing Idempotency-Key, or `owner_notice_conversation_unavailable` when the named conversation is not an open conversation of the deployment's owner

403.description: The credential is not a runtime key

404.description: Deployment not found, including one the runtime key is not scoped to

The run shows its release, status, times, how it ended, the exit code of a failed script, the cleaned error lines of its latest script that printed any and when they were last reported, and its model calls, tokens and cost, with the hire shown only as `Employer` and its number or as `Your organization`. Up to 500 of its steps follow `after`, oldest first: each step's kind, name, status, times, how many identical steps in a row it stands for, and a script's exit code or a failed step's Seren code. A tool the Employer added is named `Employer tool`. Read on by passing `next_after` as `after`; a page with no steps returns the same `next_after`. Nothing the Employer wrote or supplied is returned. Only the organization's built-in Owner or Admin can read this, on a session or a user API key; every other caller gets `404`.

ActionLease.description:
Lease for a single action on a tool. Borrows the OpenFang/IronClaw
pattern: permission is granted per-action, not per-process, with optional
expiry, use budget, and a parent lease ref for sub-agent inheritance.

`capability` distinguishes blanket grants (all sub-actions of `action`)
from a closed `Specific` set. Sub-agents that fork from a parent must
hold leases whose capability is a subset of the parent's — runtime
enforcement (when implemented) lives outside this DTO; here we validate
shape only.

action.description:
Action name being leased. Free-form per tool; e.g. `read`, `send`,
`execute`, `delete`, `list`.

expiry.description: Lease expiry as RFC 3339; `None` means no time bound.

parent_lease_ref.description:
Identifier of the parent lease this one inherits from. Shape-only
validation here checks that the value is non-empty when set; the
referenced lease is not looked up. Inheritance resolution (parent must
hold a capability superset) happens at runtime.

use_budget.description:
Maximum number of invocations before the lease must be re-issued.
`None` means unlimited.

EvalGate.description:
Eval gate configuration that must pass with a fresh verdict before runs proceed.

`block_on_failure` controls what happens at update or rollback apply time:
when `Some(true)`, the control plane rejects the apply if the latest eval
verdict has failed or has expired beyond `max_age_seconds`. The default
(`None`/`false`) preserves the original freshness-only behavior for
back-compat.

`schedule` is an operator-supplied cron expression that asks the control
plane to run the gated eval set on a fixed cadence so freshness stays
current without manual triggering. The actual scheduling-loop dispatch is
owned by the eval-set scheduler today (see `CloudEvalSetSchedule`); this
field records the operator intent on the deployment side.

`drift_baseline` is captured by the apply path when an update or rollback
commits with a passing gate. Subsequent eval runs compare against the
baseline so operators see regressions explicitly.

Eval-set verdict captured at the most recent successful apply. Set by
the control plane; clients may submit this field but the control plane
will overwrite it on every successful apply.

